@@U03967@@
Ah, another one of your crazy tales.
You no sooner arrive than you're off and running.

@@U03969@@
(Seriously.)

@@U03970@@
When the Lord God—
and I know why, too—
cast us from the sky to the deepest of pits
(with central fire blazing eternally),
we found ourselves with something
too much illumination,
not to mention overcrowded accommodations.
We devils all began to huff and puff,
fore and aft,
to put out that great blaze,
while roundabout was an acid stink of sulfur
and a pressure of gas so monstrous
it burst through earth’s flat crust,
thick as it was,
with a gigantic bang.
Yes, well, it’s a different story now.
What was once Hell’s bottom is now its top.
It’s on this they base those theories required
to turn things topsy-turvy.
In any case,
we escaped that servile place of confinement
and came to gain free dominion of the air.
An open secret, well preserved,
revealed to the world only later.

@@U03972@@
Noble as they are,
these mountains say nothing to me,
nor do I ask why or where they came from.
When Nature created nature from herself,
she neatly rounded off the earth’s vast sphere,
and rejoicing in peaks and chasms, arranged
translation:
@@U03967@@
啊，你的又一个疯狂故事。
您一到达就立即出发。

@@U03969@@
（说真的。）

@@U03970@@
当主神——
我也知道为什么——
把我们从天上扔到最深的坑里
（中心之火永远燃烧），
我们发现自己有了一些东西
光照太多，
更不用说过度拥挤的住宿条件了。
我们魔鬼都开始气喘吁吁，
前后，
扑灭那场大火，
环岛处弥漫着硫磺的酸臭味
和如此巨大的气体压力
它冲破了平坦的地壳，
尽管它很厚，
一声巨响。
是的，好吧，现在情况不同了。
曾经的地狱底部如今已是地狱顶部。
他们正是以此为基础建立了所需的理论
把事情搞得天翻地覆。
无论如何，
我们逃离了那个奴役的禁闭之地
并获得了空中的自由统治权。
公开的秘密，保存完好，
直到后来才向世人揭晓。

@@U03972@@
尽管他们高贵，
这些山对我什么也没说，
我也不问他们为什么或从哪里来。
